Charmeleon

Fire

Kanto · Generation 1

Charmeleon is a Fire-type Flame Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 19 kg. It evolves from Charmander and into Charizard. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (80), with a base stat total of 405.
